# Conflict inspection uses the selected local board and keeps JSON free of notices.
exec git init -b main
exec card --store $WORK/store init --prefix review-
exec card --store $WORK/store conflicts
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/empty.txt
! stderr .
exec card --store $WORK/store --json conflicts list
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/empty.json
! stderr .

# Repair requires an explicit choice before it opens the board.
! exec card --store $WORK/store resolve missing
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/choice.txt

-- golden/empty.txt --
No unresolved conflicts.
-- golden/empty.json --
{"conflicts":[],"next":""}
-- golden/choice.txt --
error: resolve: choose one of --take, --file, relationship repair flags, or --waiting
